2608.11197.title: Beyond a Bag of Features: Set-Level Instability in Sparse Autoencoders
2608.11197.paper_summary: Shani et al. (2026) show that LLM representations broadly recover human category boundaries, while failing to reflect fine-grained typicality structure. Their analysis uses cosine similarity over dense model representations. We revisit their approach using overlap over active sparse autoencoder (SAE) latent sets as a more interpretable similarity measure. We first verify that this set-level measure is meaningful: SAE latent sets can recover union-like compositional structure in controlled toy models and induce semantically coherent neighborhoods in natural text. Extending the human-concepts analysis to SAE set similarities, we find that SAE activation sets do not recover human category boundaries or within-category typicality more faithfully than dense embeddings or residual-stream states, but instead track model-internal similarity structure. To probe this gap further, we study active latent sets under well-controlled semantic modifications, revealing a substantial mismatch between human judgements of conceptual change and change in the SAE active set. We interpret this as evidence that, outside idealised settings, SAE features do not compose via simple bag-of-features semantics.
2608.11197.paper_summary_zh: Shani 等人 (2026) 顯示 LLM 表示廣泛地恢復了人類的類別邊界，但未能反映細緻的典型性結構。<lb/>他們的分析使用了稠密模型表示的餘弦相似度。<lb/>我們重新檢視他們的方法，使用主動稀疏自編碼器 (SAE) 潛在集的重疊作為更具可解釋性的相似性度量。<lb/>我們首先驗證這一集級度量是有意義的：SAE 潛在集可以在受控的玩具模型中恢復類似聯集的組合結構，並在自然文本中誘導語義一致的鄰域。<lb/>將人類概念分析擴展至 SAE 集相似性，我們發現 SAE 激活集並未比稠密嵌入或殘差流狀態更忠實地恢復人類類別邊界或類別內的典型性，而是追蹤模型內部的相似性結構。<lb/>為了進一步探討這一差距，我們在良好控制的語義修改下研究主動潛在集，揭示人類對概念變化的判斷與 SAE 活動集中的變化之間存在實質性不匹配。<lb/>我們將此解釋為證據，表明在理想化設置之外，SAE 特徵並不通過簡單的特徵袋語義進行組合。
